setup_audio_pretraining_task: setup an AudioPretrainingTask instance from an AudioPretrainingConfig dataclass for audio pretraining
load_audio_dataset: load a FileAudioDataset or BinarizedAudioDataset for a given split like train or valid
load_multi_corpus_dataset: load multiple corpus datasets with sampling weights using MultiCorpusDataset for audio pretraining
build_audio_model: build a wav2vec model from a model config and propagate w2v_args back to the config
run_post_save_script: run a post-save script that copies the checkpoint and executes an evaluation command
